question: Which device had the highest average CPU percentage over all recorded samples? Return its hostname and average CPU rounded to two decimals. Break ties by hostname.
sql: SELECT d.hostname, ROUND(AVG(m.cpu_pct), 2) FROM devices d JOIN device_metrics m ON m.device_id=d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.hostname ORDER BY AVG(m.cpu_pct) DESC, d.hostname LIMIT 1;

question: For November 3, 2026 UTC, count monitoring samples per site. Return site name and count, ordered by site name.
sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) FROM sites s JOIN devices d ON d.site_id=s.id JOIN device_metrics m ON m.device_id=d.id WHERE m.collected_at >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00' AND m.collected_at < '2026-11-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY s.id,s.name ORDER BY s.name;

question: Which devices never recorded CPU above 80%? Return only hostname, sorted alphabetically.
sql: SELECT d.hostname FROM devices d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_metrics m WHERE m.device_id=d.id AND m.cpu_pct>80) ORDER BY d.hostname;

question: Which sites have at least 10 samples above 80% CPU over the full dataset? Return site name and high-CPU sample count, ordered by site name.
sql: SELECT s.name,COUNT(*) FROM sites s JOIN devices d ON d.site_id=s.id JOIN device_metrics m ON m.device_id=d.id WHERE m.cpu_pct>80 GROUP BY s.id,s.name HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY s.name;

question: For each UTC date with CPU readings above 80%, return the date as YYYY-MM-DD and number of such samples, sorted by date.
sql: SELECT DATE(collected_at),COUNT(*) FROM device_metrics WHERE cpu_pct>80 GROUP BY DATE(collected_at) ORDER BY DATE(collected_at);

question: How many recorded monitoring samples belong to routers rather than switches? Return only the count.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_metrics m JOIN devices d ON m.device_id=d.id WHERE d.device_type='router';
